Episodes.Title: Is She Really Your Sister?
Episodes.Actors: Gong Yoo, Kim Go-eun, Lee Dong-wook
Episodes.Plot: After the Reaper forgets that he erased Sunny's memory and makes a slip of the tongue, she demands to know who he is and why he knows her real name.

Episodes.Title: Forget About Me
Episodes.Actors: Gong Yoo, Kim Go-eun, Lee Dong-wook
Episodes.Plot: Eun Tak remembers the Reaper's words when she sees a creepy ghost while at work. Shin and the Reaper realize that Deok Hwa is not who he seems.

Episodes.Title: Whom Have I Forgotten?
Episodes.Actors: Gong Yoo, Kim Go-eun, Lee Dong-wook
Episodes.Plot: Shin pulls out the sword to protect Eun Tak from an evil spirit. He then departs for a desolate place where he struggles against loneliness.

Episodes.Title: Will You Be My Bride?
Episodes.Actors: Gong Yoo, Kim Go-eun, Lee Dong-wook
Episodes.Plot: Eun Tak is suspicious when Shin suddenly appears on the street in Canada, but he reminds her of her promise to treat him to a meal.
